subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should `captionedFinalText` become the permanent extension-facing channel capability for final-mode TTS deferral?
rationale: The repair adds a public plugin contract that determines when core suppresses visible text, so implementation correctness alone cannot establish the desired long-term SDK boundary.

options.title: Accept the SDK capability
options.body: Keep the generic typed capability after exact-head behavior and fallback proof establishes that the contract is safe.

options.title: Narrow to Telegram ownership
options.body: Move the behavior behind a Telegram-owned seam and defer a general plugin capability until another channel requires it.

options.title: Pause the delivery change
options.body: Retain current behavior until maintainers settle the desired captioned-versus-separate delivery policy.

recommendation.title: Accept the SDK capability
recommendation.body: Keep the generic typed capability after exact-head behavior and fallback proof establishes that the contract is safe.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to the ACP, standard dispatch, and channel TTS capability surfaces defining the proposed contract.
